tasks.name_en: Stand the shelf clock that toppled face-down on the tall living-room shelf back upright on the same row, dial facing the room
tasks.name_ja: リビングの縦長の棚で文字盤を下にして倒れた置き時計を、同じ段に文字盤を部屋側に向けて立て直す
instruction_variants: The clock on the tall shelf has fallen on its face. Stand it back up on the same shelf with the dial facing the room.
Pick the clock up by its sides, not its face, and set it upright where it was, facing out.
縦長の棚の置き時計が前に倒れています。文字盤を押さえずに側面を持って、同じ段に文字盤を部屋に向けて立ててください。
tasks.notes: Atomic: one object and one goal change (fallen face-down -> standing), done in place on the same row with one grasp-rotate-set sequence; on_top_of(clock, row) holds at start and end, and facing_out is a pose qualifier of standing it up. ReplicaCAD: frl_apartment_clock stands on the second-lowest row of frl_apartment_wall_cabinet_01 (receptacle_aabb_WC1_Top5frl_apartment_wall_cabinet_01) in apt_0; the stager lays it face-down on that row. upright means the clock's base within 5 degrees of level, matching its apt_0 orientation; facing_out means the dial normal within 15 degrees of the shelf-front normal; on_top_of means the whole footprint on the row with no part past its front edge. The clock is grasped by its two side faces; pressure on the dial is a failure. The three frl_apartment_book_01 copies higher on the same shelf must not move. Related active task: task_thor_r3_statue_toppled_stand_upright_on_shelf also rights a toppled item on a display shelf; the difference here is a thin (6.3 cm deep) flat-faced object lying on its dial, which must be rolled up by its sides without pressing the face and must end facing a set direction, on a row 0.5 m above the floor that needs a low reach.

tasks.name_en: Move the living-room bin that was pulled into the walkway between the sofa and the TV stand back onto its floor mark beside the side table
tasks.name_ja: ソファとテレビ台の間の通路に出ているリビングのごみ箱を、サイドテーブル横の床の印の位置へ戻す
instruction_variants: Someone dragged the bin into the walkway. Put it back on its spot next to the side table.

ソファとテレビの間の通路に出ているごみ箱を、サイドテーブルの横の元の位置に立てて戻してください。
tasks.notes: Atomic: one object and one goal change (bin in the walkway -> on its home mark), one lift-carry-set sequence of about 1 m; outside_zone follows from at_floor_mark and upright holds throughout (a pose qualifier, not a separate change). ReplicaCAD: frl_apartment_bin_03 (1.81 kg, 33 x 61 x 47 cm) stands in apt_0 about 0.5 m from the side table frl_apartment_table_04; that footprint is taped as rcad_resource_bin_03_home_mark. The stager moves the bin 1 m into rcad_resource_sofa_tv_walkway, an 80 cm-wide taped band between frl_apartment_sofa and frl_apartment_tvstand. at_floor_mark means the bin's footprint centre within 5 cm of the mark centre and its rotation within 10 degrees of the apt_0 yaw; outside_zone means no part of the bin over the walkway tape. The side table must not move more than 2 cm. The bin is empty (the mesh models no contents). Related active task: task_thor_r2_newspaper_bin_empty_to_kitchen_can empties a living-room bin and relines it; here the bin is only put back in place to clear a walkway, with no emptying.

tasks.notes: Atomic: one object and one goal change (on edge -> flat on its outline), done in place with one grasp-lower-align sequence; on_top_of is where the flat pose must be reached. ReplicaCAD: frl_apartment_setupbox is STATIC in apt_0, lying flat 1.04 m above the floor at the foot of frl_apartment_monitor_stand in the office corner; the task sets it DYNAMIC and the stager stands it on its long edge leaning on the stand. That apt_0 footprint is rcad_resource_setupbox_desk_mark, a 17 x 16 cm outline. lying_flat means its 16.6 x 15.9 cm face down within 3 degrees of level; either face may be up because the mesh is untextured. on_top_of means its centre within 2 cm of the outline centre and yaw within 10 degrees. The monitor and stand are STATIC and must not be contacted; the camera on the high shelf above (see task_rcad_r1_camera_02_high_shelf_to_desk) is out of reach and untouched. No active task restores a thin flat device knocked onto its edge.

instruction_variants: The shoebox is sitting on the hall chair. Put it back up where it lives, all the way on the shelf.

tasks.notes: Atomic: one object and one goal change (on the chair seat -> on its shelf spot), in one lift-reach-place sequence; no_overhang and upright are qualifiers of that placement. ReplicaCAD: frl_apartment_shoebox_01 (0.3 kg, 30 x 15.5 x 30 cm) sits in apt_0 with its base about 1.31 m above the floor, about 0.25 m from the centre of chestOfDrawers_01; the scene does not name the supporting surface, so rcad_resource_entry_shoebox_shelf_spot is that apt_0 footprint on whichever surface holds it, confirmed in setup. The entry chair is frl_apartment_chair_04 near the shoe rack. on_top_of means the box's footprint centre within 5 cm of the apt_0 footprint centre; no_overhang means no part of the box past the surface's front or side edge; upright means the lid face up within 5 degrees. The mesh is closed, so the physical box's lid is taped on. Related tasks: task_gso_r3_hair_colour_box_store_above_child_reach puts a small carton flat on a top cabinet shelf above a child-reach line; this task lifts a wide, light box from a seat to a 1.3 m entry surface where the 30 cm-deep box must end fully supported. task_rcad_r1_camera_02_high_shelf_to_desk brings an item down from a high shelf; here the motion is upward storage.

tasks.name_en: Seat the loose YCB sponge in the sponge holder dish on the kitchen counter, lying flat inside the rim, without moving the dish
tasks.name_ja: 調理台に出ているYCBのスポンジを、スポンジ置きを動かさずに、縁の内側に平らに収める
instruction_variants: Put the sponge back in its dish on the counter, flat.
The sponge is lying loose on the worktop; drop it into the sponge holder without shoving the holder.
調理台に置きっぱなしのスポンジを、スポンジ置きの中に平らに入れてください。スポンジ置きは動かさないで。
tasks.notes: Atomic: one moved object and one goal change (sponge on the worktop -> seated in the dish), one pick-place motion; lying_flat is a pose qualifier, and the dish's on_top_of holds at start and end (preserved, within 1 cm). The anchor is the ReplicaCAD holder frl_apartment_sponge_dish at its apt_0 spot on the counter worktop (receptacle_aabb_counter_right_kitchen_counter) beside cup_02 and bowl_06; the sponge is the atlas ycb_026_sponge (present in ai-habitat/ycb) placed 40 cm away on the same worktop. The dish config defines no receptacle, so the seat region is the top opening inside the dish rim, measured on the mesh in setup. inside means the sponge's footprint wholly inside the rim seen from above; lying_flat means its largest face down within 15 degrees. The sponge is dry. Related active tasks: task_ycb_round3_sponge rinses and stages a sponge, and task_ycb_round4_sponge_cloth_cleaning_caddy stages it in a caddy slot; this task has no rinsing and targets the apartment's own holder dish, which must not move.

tasks.name_en: Move the small media device on the TV stand along the stand until it is centred below the TV screen, front facing the sofa

instruction_variants: Move the little box on the TV stand so it sits right under the middle of the TV, front toward the sofa.

テレビ台の端にある小さな機器を、テレビ画面のちょうど真ん中の下へ動かして、前面をソファに向けてください。
tasks.notes: Atomic: one object and one goal change (device near the end of the stand -> centred below the screen), in one lift-move-set sequence along the same stand top; front_toward is a pose qualifier and on_top_of holds throughout. ReplicaCAD: frl_apartment_tv_object (1.5 kg, 25.6 x 6.6 x 18.9 cm; speaker or console, identity unconfirmed) is DYNAMIC on top of frl_apartment_tvstand (receptacle_aabb_TvStnd1_Top1_frl_apartment_tvstand) in apt_0, about 0.97 m along the stand from the point below the centre of the STATIC frl_apartment_tv_screen. Its front is the face that points toward frl_apartment_sofa in its apt_0 pose; the stager marks it with a tape dot. centred_below means the device centre within 3 cm of the vertical plane through the screen centre, perpendicular to the stand's long edge; front_toward means the front-face normal within 15 degrees of the direction to the sofa's centre; the device must stay at least 3 cm in from the stand's front edge. The two remotes on the stand (rcad_resource_tv_remote_a, _b) stay within 1 cm. No active task positions a device relative to a fixed screen.

tasks.name_en: Take the master chef can and the tomato soup can out of the left solid-door cupboard through its right leaf only, stand them on the counter, and shut that leaf
tasks.name_ja: 左側の扉付き戸棚から、右側の扉だけを開けてマスターシェフ缶とトマトスープ缶を出し、調理台に立てて置いて扉を閉める
instruction_variants: Get the chef can and the soup can out of the left cupboard for dinner. Only open the right-hand door of that pair, and shut it after.
Both cans are behind the right leaf of the left solid doors. Stand them on the counter and don't touch the other leaf.
左の扉付き戸棚の右側の扉だけを開けて、マスターシェフ缶とトマトスープ缶を調理台に出し、扉を閉めてください。左側の扉は開けないでください。
tasks.notes: Compound: two items and two goal changes (each can from the shelf to the worktop, standing), plus one transient articulation that must be reversed (doorWhole_1R_hinge opened, then closed). closed(doorWhole_1R_hinge) is a preserved end state; closed(doorWhole_1L_hinge) must hold throughout, so it is a preserved constraint listed in the goal only so a reviewer can see which leaf stays shut; the other six cupboard doors also stay closed. ReplicaCAD kitchenCupboard_01: doorWhole_1L_hinge and doorWhole_1R_hinge are the solid pair over the shelf_center_*_left column (door-to-column mapping inferred from hinge positions, see the object notes); the R hinge opens 0 to 2.3 rad and counts as closed within 0.02 rad of 0. The cans start on the middle shelf of that column (receptacle_aabb_shelf_center_middle_left_kitchenCupboard_01, resource rcad_resource_cupboard_shelf_behind_doorwhole_1) in its half behind the 1R leaf. The leaf is opened at least 1.2 rad. The worktop is receptacle_aabb_counter_left_kitchen_counter; upright means within 10 degrees of vertical. Related task: task_rcad_r1_grocery_basket_unpack_both_fridge_doors_cupboard stocks the same column with a cracker box and soup can through both leaves; here two cans come back out through one leaf of the pair, reaching past the closed leaf, which is the distinct constraint. Also similar in shape: task_rcad_r1_bowl_right_top_drawer_to_dining_table (one bowl out of a counter drawer to the table, drawer closed) and task_rcad_r1_cupboard_glass_door_close_clear_of_cups (closing a glass cupboard door clear of its contents); neither opens only one leaf of a solid pair or takes items past a leaf that stays shut.

tasks.name_en: Bring the chopping board from the dining table's lower shelf and the one standing by the knife block, and lay both flat in the counter's middle-middle drawer, then close it

instruction_variants: Both chopping boards live in the middle drawer of the middle stack. One is under the dining table, one is by the knife block; put them in flat and shut it.
Gather the two boards and lay them in the counter's centre drawer, one on the other. Leave the drawers above and below it shut.
ダイニングテーブルの下の段にあるまな板と、包丁立ての横のまな板を、調理台の真ん中の列の中段の引き出しに平らに重ねてしまい、引き出しを閉めてください。
tasks.notes: Compound: two objects and two goal changes (each board into drawer_middle_middle, flat), gathered from two places about 3 m apart (dining area and kitchen) in one sitting, plus a transient articulation (middle_slide_middle opened, then closed). closed(middle_slide_middle) is a preserved end state; middle_slide_top and middle_slide_bottom must stay closed throughout (preserved constraints).
